requestId.description: ID of the original criteria calculation request.

matches.description: Criteria check result. Required on any response but an explicit `success: false` one — `success` is optional and defaults to true, so a response that omits it is a successful one. A criterion decides a transition, so a successful response that omits `matches`, or sends null, is refused as an answer that could not be read rather than read as false. A `success: false` response carries no result.

reason.description: Reason for the criteria check result.
